summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing a director/PDMR share transaction: Philippa Bounds, Chief Legal Officer, disposed of 8,000 ordinary shares at GBP 33.80 per share on July 31, 2026, for a total of GBP 270,400 on the London Stock Exchange. This is a routine insider transaction notification under EU/UK market abuse rules, not a special situation.
